body: I support this. No comment from me.
Motion 58 is now open for all the council members to provide a soft signal to convert the proposal into a simple majority referendum.

OnFinality has been providing the load-balancer based RPC node infrastructure for over a year now. Grateful to the OnFinality team for such consistent service to the Edgeware community.
One can find their past commitments/proposals here:
